client_claims.text: Monzo offers arranged overdrafts in the UK for eligible personal current account holders aged 18 and over.
Rates: 19%, 29%, or 39% EAR (variable). Most customers are offered the representative rate of 39% EAR.
Limits: Up to £2,000 (or up to £3,000 for select customers).
There are no extra setup fees, late fees, or charges for declined payments if you hit your limit.
If you borrow £1,200 for 30 days at 39.0% EAR (variable), it will cost you £32.94 in interest.
client_claims.note: No fact covers the representative example.

client_claims.text: Monzo checks eligibility using account data and credit reference agencies (TransUnion, Experian, and Equifax); checking in the app uses a soft search.
You can switch your overdraft on, adjust your limit, or cancel it anytime in the Monzo app.
Monzo will normally decline transactions past your limit for free, and won't charge extra fees for offline payments causing an unarranged overdraft.
